# SMV — Singer Media Vision

> Media production agency based in Dubai and Sharjah, United Arab Emirates. Event coverage, commercial videography, aerial filming and post-production for government summits, exhibitions and national celebrations, with same-day delivery.

## Services
- Event coverage (summits, exhibitions, ceremonies): https://ashrafselomotion-afk.github.io/smv-cinematic/#services
- Commercial and brand films: https://ashrafselomotion-afk.github.io/smv-cinematic/#services
- Aerial / drone filming: https://ashrafselomotion-afk.github.io/smv-cinematic/#services
- Post-production, editing and color grading: https://ashrafselomotion-afk.github.io/smv-cinematic/#services

## Locations
Dubai (A34, Design District) and Sharjah (Media City FZ); crews deploy UAE-wide.
